keyword: how many 16 seeds beat a 1 seed
claims: A No. 16 seed has defeated a No. 1 seed only twice in 160 matchups in the history of the men's NCAA tournament.
UMBC (University of Maryland, Baltimore County) defeated Virginia 74-54 in 2018.
FDU (Fairleigh Dickinson University) defeated Purdue 63-58 in 2023.
KVUE notes that prior to 2018, No. 1 seeds were 135-0 against No. 16 seeds.
NCAA.com says that excluding these two instances, No. 1 seeds have a 158-2 overall record against No. 16 seeds in this matchup
